The change bounds each mort reader to its own subtable and interprets contextual entry offsets as signed 16-bit word offsets. For each nonzero offset, it reads all glyph replacements from `max(0, ceil(substOffset / 2) - offset)` up to `min(numGlyphs, floor(size / 2) - offset)`, exactly covering words contained in both the substitution table and the subtable for either offset sign.
